ep01.title: Episode 01: The Moral Side of Murder / The Case for Cannibalism
ep01.cn_title: 第 01 集：杀人的道德侧面 / 海难食人案司法审判
ep01.topic: 电车难题（Trolley Problem）与英国木犀草号真实海难食人案（R v Dudley and Stephens）

words.sentence: This is a course about Justice and we begin with a story. Suppose you're the driver of a trolley car, and your trolley car is hurdling down the track at sixty miles an hour.
words.sentence_cn: 这是一门关于公正的课程，我们从一个故事开始。假设你是一辆有轨电车的司机，你的电车正以每小时六十英里的速度在轨道上飞驰。
words.speaker: Prof. Michael Sandel
words.why: 贯穿全课的核心案例名词，理解道德困境场景的关键词。
words.def_en: an electric vehicle running on rails that carries passengers along city streets
words.scene_desc: 哈佛《公正》课堂现场 · 时间戳 [00:33]

words.sentence: Whereas pushing the fat man over is an actual act of murder on your part. You have control over that.
words.sentence_cn: 而把那个胖子推下去，则是你这边实实在在的谋杀行为。这一点你是能控制的。
words.speaker: Prof. Michael Sandel
words.why: 法理学与道德哲学中区分杀人与谋杀的核心术语。
words.def_en: the crime of deliberately killing someone
words.scene_desc: 哈佛《公正》课堂现场 · 时间戳 [07:48]

words.sentence: Well I think that same type of mentality that justifies genocide and totalitarianism in order to save one type of race you wipe out the other.
words.sentence_cn: 嗯，我觉得正是那种为种族灭绝和极权主义辩护的同一类思维方式——为了拯救一个种族，你就消灭另一个种族。
words.speaker: Prof. Michael Sandel
words.why: 政治哲学与法理学中讨论极端不义的高频学术词。
words.def_en: the deliberate killing of a large group of people because of their race or religion
words.scene_desc: 哈佛《公正》课堂现场 · 时间戳 [03:40]

words.speaker: Prof. Michael Sandel
words.why: 道德论证中表示“使正当化”的核心动词。
words.def_en: to give a good reason for something that seems wrong
words.scene_desc: 哈佛《公正》课堂现场 · 时间戳 [03:40]

words.sentence: Here's the obvious question, what became of the principle better to save five lives even if it means sacrificing one, what became of the principal that almost everyone endorsed in the first case?
words.sentence_cn: 这里有个显而易见的问题：那个“宁可牺牲一个人也要救五个人”的原则怎么了？那个在第一个案例中几乎所有人都赞同的原则怎么了？
words.speaker: Prof. Michael Sandel
words.why: 功利主义论证中“牺牲一人救五人”的关键动词。
words.def_en: giving up something valuable for the sake of something else

words.sentence_cn: 这一次你不是电车司机，而是一个旁观者，站在一座桥上，俯瞰着一条电车轨道。
words.speaker: Prof. Michael Sandel
words.why: 区分司机与旁观者道德责任的重要角色词。
words.def_en: n. someone who looks on

words.def_en: a particular way of thinking or attitude

words.sentence: So the principle there was the same on 9/11. It's tragic circumstance, but better to kill one so that five can live is that the reason most of you have, those of you who would turn, yes?
words.sentence_cn: 所以那里的原则和9/11时是一样的。这是个悲惨的情况，但杀一个人好让五个人活下来，这是你们大多数人的理由吗，你们这些会这么做的人，是吗？
words.speaker: Prof. Michael Sandel
words.why: 道德判断中描述情境因素的高频学术名词。
words.def_en: a fact or situation that affects what happens or what you can do
words.scene_desc: 哈佛《公正》课堂现场 · 时间戳 [03:16]

words.sentence: Here's the obvious question, what became of the principle better to save five lives even if it means sacrificing one, what became of the principal that almost everyone endorsed in the first case?
words.sentence_cn: 这里有个显而易见的问题：那个“宁可牺牲一个人也要救五个人”的原则怎么了？那个在第一个案例中几乎所有人都赞同的原则怎么了？
words.speaker: Prof. Michael Sandel
words.why: 表示对道德原则的公开支持，学术论证常用词。
words.def_en: agreed with or approved of a principle or idea
words.scene_desc: 哈佛《公正》课堂现场 · 时间戳 [05:54]

words.sentence: Who else can find a way of reconciling the reaction of the majority in these two cases? Yes?
words.sentence_cn: 还有谁能找到一种办法，把这两种情况下大多数人的反应调和起来？有吗？
words.speaker: Prof. Michael Sandel
words.why: 哲学论证中调和矛盾直觉的关键动词。
words.def_en: making two different ideas or situations exist together without conflict
words.scene_desc: 哈佛《公正》课堂现场 · 时间戳 [07:19]

words.sentence: Whereas pushing the fat man over is an actual act of murder on your part. You have control over that.
words.sentence_cn: 而把那个胖子推下去，则是你这边实实在在的谋杀行为。这一点你是能控制的。
words.speaker: Prof. Michael Sandel
words.why: 学术写作与论证中表示对比的重要连接词。
words.def_en: used to contrast two facts or situations
words.scene_desc: 哈佛《公正》课堂现场 · 时间戳 [07:48]

words.sentence: Not necessarily because of your direct actions. The trolley car is a runaway thing and you need to make in a split second choice.
words.sentence_cn: 这未必是因为你的直接行为。电车已经失控了，你必须在瞬间做出选择。
words.speaker: Prof. Michael Sandel
words.why: 哲学论证中表达必然性判断的常用副词。
words.def_en: in a way that is certain or cannot be avoided
words.scene_desc: 哈佛《公正》课堂现场 · 时间戳 [07:41]

words.sentence: Which is an act of conscious thought to turn, or you choose to push the fat man?
words.sentence_cn: 要么是有意识地扳动道岔，要么是你选择把那个胖子推下去？
words.speaker: Prof. Michael Sandel
words.why: 区分故意行为与无意行为，道德责任讨论核心词。
words.def_en: done on purpose after thinking about it
words.scene_desc: 哈佛《公正》课堂现场 · 时间戳 [08:16]

words.sentence: over which is also an active conscious action. So either way you're making a choice.
words.sentence_cn: 这也是一种主动的、有意识的行为。所以无论哪种方式，你都是在做选择。
words.speaker: Prof. Michael Sandel
words.why: 与“被动”相对，用于区分作为与不作为的道德分量。
words.def_en: involving deliberate effort or conscious choice
words.scene_desc: 哈佛《公正》课堂现场 · 时间戳 [08:21]

words.sentence: Whereas pushing the fat man over is an actual act of murder on your part. You have control over that.
words.sentence_cn: 而把那个胖子推下去，则是你这边实实在在的谋杀行为。这一点你是能控制的。
words.speaker: Prof. Michael Sandel
words.why: 学术论证中区分实际行为与假设情形的常用词。
words.def_en: real and existing in fact, not just imagined
words.scene_desc: 哈佛《公正》课堂现场 · 时间戳 [07:48]

words.sentence: Let's assume you know that for sure, and so you feel helpless.
words.sentence_cn: 让我们假定你确信这一点，因此你感到无助。
words.speaker: Prof. Michael Sandel
words.why: 哲学思想实验中设定前提的核心动词。
words.def_en: to accept something as true without proof
words.scene_desc: 哈佛《公正》课堂现场 · 时间戳 [01:01]

words.sentence: So what would you do in this case? You would to avoid the horrors of genocide you would crash into the five and kill them? Presumably yes.
words.sentence_cn: 那么在这种情况下你会怎么做？为了避免种族灭绝的恐怖，你会撞向那五个人并杀死他们？大概是这样吧。
words.speaker: Prof. Michael Sandel
words.why: 学术推理中表达推测性结论的常用副词。
words.def_en: used to say that something is likely to be true although not certain
words.scene_desc: 哈佛《公正》课堂现场 · 时间戳 [03:50]

words.sentence: Let's hear first. Now we need to begin to investigate the reasons why you think.
words.sentence_cn: 我们先来听听。现在我们需要开始探究你们这样想的理由。
words.speaker: Prof. Michael Sandel
words.why: 学术探究中表示系统考察理由的常用动词。
words.def_en: to try to find out the truth about something by examining it carefully
words.scene_desc: 哈佛《公正》课堂现场 · 时间戳 [02:08]

words.sentence: Let's hear first. Now we need to begin to investigate the reasons why you think.
words.sentence_cn: 我们先来听听。现在我们需要开始探究你们这样想的理由。
words.speaker: Prof. Michael Sandel
words.why: 道德哲学中“理由”是论证的基本单位。
words.def_en: the facts or causes that explain why something happens or is done
words.scene_desc: 哈佛《公正》课堂现场 · 时间戳 [02:08]

words.sentence: Well I guess in the first case where you have the one worker and the five it's a choice between those two, and you have to make a certain choice and people are going to die because of the trolley car.
words.sentence_cn: 嗯，我想在第一种情况里，你面对的是一个工人和五个人，这是在这两者之间做选择，你必须做出某个选择，而人们会因为那辆电车而死。
words.speaker: Prof. Michael Sandel
words.why: 自由意志与道德责任讨论中的核心概念。
words.def_en: a decision to pick one thing or person instead of another
words.scene_desc: 哈佛《公正》课堂现场 · 时间戳 [07:30]

words.sentence: I don't think that's a very good reason because you choose either way you have to choose who dies because you either choose to turn and kill a person.
words.sentence_cn: 我觉得那不是个很好的理由，因为无论哪种方式，你都得选择谁死，因为你要么选择扳道岔杀死一个人，
words.speaker: Prof. Michael Sandel
words.why: 与 choice 对应，表示道德主体作出抉择的动词。
words.def_en: to decide which one you want from two or more possibilities
words.scene_desc: 哈佛《公正》课堂现场 · 时间戳 [08:09]

words.sentence: Who's willing to volunteer a reason? Go ahead, stand up. Because it can't be right to kill five people when you can only kill one person instead. It wouldn't be right to kill five if you could kill one person instead.
words.sentence_cn: 谁愿意自告奋勇说个理由？来吧，站起来。因为明明可以只杀一个人，却要杀五个人，这肯定不对。明明可以只杀一个人，却要杀五个人，这是不对的。
words.speaker: Prof. Michael Sandel
words.why: 讨论道德意愿与责任时常用的形容词。
words.def_en: ready or eager to do something
words.scene_desc: 哈佛《公正》课堂现场 · 时间戳 [02:25]

words.sentence: Keep your hands up, those of you who'd go straight ahead. A handful of people would, the vast majority would turn.
words.sentence_cn: 会直行的人，把手举着。少数人会直行，绝大多数人会转向。
words.speaker: Prof. Michael Sandel
words.why: 课堂投票与民主理论中表示多数意见的核心词。
words.def_en: the larger part or number of a group
words.scene_desc: 哈佛《公正》课堂现场 · 时间戳 [01:58]

words.sentence: Fair enough, it still seems wrong in a way that it doesn't seem wrong in the first case to turn, you say.
words.sentence_cn: 有道理，但你说，它在某种意义上仍然显得不对，而在第一种情况下转动方向盘却并不显得不对。
words.speaker: Prof. Michael Sandel
words.why: 正义理论中表示公平的核心形容词。
words.def_en: reasonable and acceptable in the circumstances
words.scene_desc: 哈佛《公正》课堂现场 · 时间戳 [09:39]

words.def_en: feeling that you have no hope and must take extreme action

words.sentence: Five of them sustained moderate injuries, one is severely injured. You could spend all day caring for the one severely injured victim.

words.sentence: Certain moral principles have already begun to emerge from the discussions we've had.

words.sentence: The first moral principle that emerged from the discussion said that the right thing to do, the moral thing to do, depends on the consequences that will result from your action.

words.sentence: Plato argues that justice in the soul is a condition of internal psychic harmony.
words.trans: 柏拉图指出，心灵中的正义是内在心理和谐的一种境界。
words.speaker: Prof. Tamar Gendler
words.scene_desc: 耶鲁大讲堂：理想国心灵秩序开篇
words.sentence_cn: 柏拉图认为，灵魂中的正义是一种内在心灵和谐的状态。
words.def_en: a state of peaceful agreement among different parts

words.sentence: The rational part of our mind seeks truth, wisdom, and genuine understanding.
words.trans: 我们心灵中理性的部分，探求的是真理、智慧与真实的理解。
words.speaker: Prof. Tamar Gendler
words.scene_desc: 理性统摄心灵模型
words.sentence_cn: 我们心灵中的理性部分追求真理、智慧与真正的理解。
words.def_en: based on clear thought and logic rather than emotion

words.sentence: When our rational reflection clashes with bodily desires, we experience acute internal conflict.
words.trans: 当我们的理性反思与肉体欲望发生碰撞时，我们会经历剧烈的内在冲突。
words.speaker: Prof. Tamar Gendler
words.scene_desc: 内在心理矛盾与拉扯
words.sentence_cn: 当我们的理性反思与身体欲望发生冲突时，我们就会体验到剧烈的内心冲突。

words.sentence: For Aristotle, moral virtue is acquired through regular habituation and deliberate practice.

words.speaker: Prof. Tamar Gendler
words.scene_desc: 亚里士多德习惯论与德性养成
words.sentence_cn: 在亚里士多德看来，道德德性是通过经常性的习惯养成和刻意的练习获得的。

words.sentence: Philosophical reflection allows us to critically evaluate impulses before acting upon them.

words.sentence: A well-ordered soul keeps each of its three constituent parts in proper proportion.
words.trans: 一个秩序井然的心灵，将其由三个部分组成的各要素保持在恰如其分的比例之中。

words.def_cn: 繁荣，昌盛；蓬勃发展（潜能完全实现）

words.scene_desc: 亚里士多德‘繁盛幸福’概念辨析

words.sentence_cn: 认知心理学揭示，我们原始的本能往往比有意识的推理反应得更快。

words.sentence: Aristotle defines eudaimonia as an activity of the soul in accordance with complete virtue.
words.trans: 亚里士多德将‘至善幸福’定义为一种符合完满德性的人性灵魂活动。
words.speaker: Prof. Tamar Gendler
words.scene_desc: 至善论与快乐论的本质分野
words.sentence_cn: 亚里士多德将至善幸福定义为灵魂依照完满德性而进行的活动。
words.def_en: the state of living a full and good life by realizing one's true potential through virtuous action

words.def_cn: 节制，克制，自律（古希腊四主德之一）
words.sentence: In Plato's Republic, temperance is the harmonious agreement between reason, spirit, and appetite.
words.trans: 在柏拉图的《理想国》中，节制是理性、激情与欲望三者之间的和谐共识。
words.speaker: Prof. Tamar Gendler
words.scene_desc: 柏拉图四主德之节制篇
words.sentence_cn: 在柏拉图的《理想国》中，节制是理性、激情与欲望之间的和谐一致。
words.def_en: the quality of controlling one's desires and acting with self-restraint

words.def_cn: 欲望，感官冲动（追求生理与感官满足的心理要素）
words.sentence: Reason must govern the baser appetites of the human soul to maintain psychological equilibrium.
words.trans: 理性必须支配人类灵魂中低级的欲望，以维持心理的平衡状态。
words.speaker: Prof. Tamar Gendler
words.scene_desc: 欲望控制模型
words.sentence_cn: 理性必须支配人类灵魂中较为低下的欲望，才能维持心理的平衡。
words.def_en: a strong natural desire, especially for food, pleasure, or satisfaction

words.def_cn: 认知的，感知的，思维结构的
words.sentence: Modern cognitive science confirms that moral judgment relies on both intuitive heuristic processes and deliberate reflection.
words.trans: 现代认知科学证实，道德判断同时依赖于直觉启发式过程与深思熟虑的理性反思。
words.speaker: Prof. Tamar Gendler
words.scene_desc: 认知心理学双进程模型
words.sentence_cn: 现代认知科学证实，道德判断既依赖直觉式的启发式过程，也依赖深思熟虑的反思。
words.def_en: relating to thinking, understanding, and mental processes

words.def_cn: 由三部分组成的，三分的
words.sentence: Plato proposes a famous tripartite division of the human soul: reason, spirit, and appetite.
words.trans: 柏拉图提出了著名的灵魂三分论：理性、激情与欲望。
words.speaker: Prof. Tamar Gendler
words.scene_desc: 灵魂三分说结构图解
words.sentence_cn: 柏拉图提出了著名的人类灵魂三分法：理性、激情与欲望。
words.def_en: having three distinct parts or divisions

words.sentence: In the Phaedrus, Socrates likens the soul to a charioteer driving two winged steeds with conflicting natures.
words.trans: 在《费德鲁斯篇》中，苏格拉底将灵魂比作一位驾驶着两匹性格截然不同之飞马的双轮战车御者。
words.speaker: Prof. Tamar Gendler
words.scene_desc: 双马战车寓言解析
words.sentence_cn: 在《斐德罗篇》中，苏格拉底将灵魂比作一位驾驭着两匹天性冲突的带翼骏马的御者。
words.def_en: a person who drives a horse-drawn vehicle used in ancient races and battles

words.def_cn: 【哲学】无自制力，软弱，明知故犯（知道正确的事却屈服于欲望）
words.sentence: The ancient philosophical problem of akrasia investigates why we act against our own better moral judgment.
words.trans: 古代哲学中关于‘无自制力’（Akrasia）的课题，探究的是为什么我们会明知故犯地做出违背自己更好道德判断的事。
words.speaker: Prof. Tamar Gendler
words.scene_desc: 意志软弱与欲望诱惑
words.sentence_cn: 古代哲学中的无自制力问题，探究的是我们为什么会违背自己更好的道德判断而行动。
words.def_en: the state of acting against what one knows is best

words.sentence: Aristotle concluded that the highest form of eudaimonia is found in philosophical contemplation.
words.trans: 亚里士多德得出结论：至善幸福的最高形态，存在于哲学的纯粹理性沉思观照之中。
words.speaker: Prof. Tamar Gendler
words.scene_desc: 沉思生活（Theoria）
words.sentence_cn: 亚里士多德得出结论：幸福的最高形式存在于哲学沉思之中。
words.def_en: the activity of thinking deeply and quietly about important things

words.def_cn: 享乐主义（将追逐当下生理快感视为人生唯一目标）
words.sentence: Socrates contrasts genuine virtue with crude hedonism that seeks only immediate sensory gratification.
words.trans: 苏格拉底将真正的美德，与只追求即时感官满足的粗陋享乐主义进行了鲜明对照。
words.speaker: Prof. Tamar Gendler
words.scene_desc: 享乐与德性的截然不同
words.sentence_cn: 苏格拉底将真正的美德与只追求当下感官满足的粗陋享乐主义相对照。
words.def_en: the belief that pleasure is the only good in life

words.def_cn: 斯多葛哲学，坚忍主义，不为外物所动
words.sentence: Stoicism teaches that peace of mind comes from distinguishing what is within our control from what is not.
words.trans: 斯多葛学派教导我们：心灵的安宁来源于区分什么是我们可以掌控的，而什么是在我们掌控之外的。
words.speaker: Prof. Tamar Gendler
words.scene_desc: 爱比克泰德与斯多葛智慧
words.sentence_cn: 斯多葛哲学教导我们，内心的平静来自分清哪些事在我们掌控之中、哪些不在。
words.def_en: the belief that we should stay calm and accept what we cannot control

words.sentence: A healthy mind achieves dynamic equilibrium when reason guides our emotional passions without violently repressing them.
words.trans: 一个健康的心智，在理性引导而非暴力压制我们的情绪激情时，方能达成充满生机的动态平衡。
words.speaker: Prof. Tamar Gendler
words.scene_desc: 身心平衡的理想境界
words.sentence_cn: 当理性引导我们的情感激情而不强行压制它们时，健康的心灵便达到动态平衡。
words.def_en: a state of balance in which different forces or feelings are equal

words.sentence: Wisdom, courage, temperance, and justice constitute the four cardinal virtues of classical Greek thought.
words.trans: 智慧、勇气、节制与正义，构成了古希腊古典哲学的四大基要主德。
words.speaker: Prof. Tamar Gendler
words.scene_desc: 古典四主德图解
words.sentence_cn: 智慧、勇敢、节制和正义构成了古典希腊思想中的四大主要德性。
words.def_en: most important or fundamental among a set of things

words.def_cn: 【柏拉图心理哲学】灵魂三分说（理性 Logistikon、激情 Thumos、欲望 Epithumetikon）
words.sentence: Plato's tripartite theory of the soul maps onto his ideal republic: philosopher kings, guardians, and producers.
words.trans: 柏拉图的灵魂三分说映射至他的理想城邦之中：哲学王对应理性，卫士对应激情，生产者对应欲望。
words.speaker: Prof. Tamar Gendler
words.scene_desc: 理想国城邦与心灵同构说
words.sentence_cn: 柏拉图的灵魂三分说对应着他理想城邦中的三个阶层：哲学王、护卫者与生产者。
words.def_en: the idea that the soul has three separate parts: reason, spirit, and desire

words.def_cn: 【柏拉图经典寓言】双马战车寓言（黑马代表桀骜欲望，白马代表崇高激情，御者代表理性）
words.sentence: In the allegory of the chariot, the charioteer must steer a noble white steed and a recalcitrant dark steed toward the heavens.
words.trans: 在双马战车寓言中，战车御者必须驾驭一匹高贵的白马与一匹桀骜不驯的黑马，共同向着天国真理飞驰。
words.speaker: Prof. Tamar Gendler
words.scene_desc: 费德鲁斯战车画卷
words.sentence_cn: 在战车寓言中，御者必须驾驭一匹高贵的白马和一匹桀骜不驯的黑马，朝着天国前行。
words.def_en: a picture-story in which a driver controls two horses, one good and one wild, to show how reason guides the soul

words.def_cn: 【柏拉图正义观】内在正义（心灵各部分恪尽职守、互不越俎代庖的良序状态）
words.sentence: Platonic justice is defined as each part of the soul minding its own proper business without meddling in the others.
words.trans: 柏拉图式的正义被定义为心灵的每一个部分都恪尽本分，互不逾矩或越俎代庖。
words.speaker: Prof. Tamar Gendler
words.scene_desc: 各司其职的正义定义
words.sentence_cn: 柏拉图式的正义被界定为：灵魂的每一部分各司其职，互不越俎代庖。
words.def_en: the state of a soul where each part does its own job without interfering with others

words.def_cn: 【规范伦理学】亚里士多德德性伦理学（强调品德修养与实践智慧 Phronesis，而非死板准则）
words.sentence: Aristotelian virtue ethics focuses on the character of the moral agent rather than adherence to strict utilitarian rules.
words.trans: 亚里士多德德性伦理学聚焦于道德践行者本人的品格与修养，而非机械遵循严苛的功利准则。
words.speaker: Prof. Tamar Gendler
words.scene_desc: 德性伦理学总纲
words.sentence_cn: 亚里士多德德性伦理学关注的是道德行为者的品格，而非对严格功利主义规则的遵守。
words.def_en: an ethical theory emphasizing good character and practical wisdom over rigid moral rules

words.def_cn: 【中庸之道】黄金中道原则（美德是介于不及与过度两个极端之间的适度适中）
words.sentence: Aristotle's doctrine of the mean defines virtue as a golden mean between two opposing vices of excess and deficiency.
words.trans: 亚里士多德的中道学说将美德定义为介于过度与不及两种对立恶德之间的黄金分割适度点。
words.speaker: Prof. Tamar Gendler
words.scene_desc: 过犹不及与适度之美
words.sentence_cn: 亚里士多德的中庸之道把德性定义为介于过度与不及这两种对立恶习之间的黄金中道。
words.def_en: the idea that virtue lies at the balanced middle point between two opposite extremes

words.def_cn: 【希腊至善论】德性繁盛生活（人性潜能得到完全充分实现的生活终极目标）
words.sentence: Eudaimonic flourishing differs fundamentally from transient hedonic pleasure by requiring moral integrity and noble activity.
words.trans: 至善繁盛在根本上不同于转瞬即逝的感官快乐，它必须以道德操守与高尚的生命行动为必要前提。
words.speaker: Prof. Tamar Gendler
words.scene_desc: 至善生活内在图景
words.sentence_cn: 德性幸福与短暂的享乐快感有着根本区别，因为它要求道德操守和高尚的行为。
words.def_en: a life of true human flourishing achieved by fully developing one's potential through moral virtue and noble deeds

words.def_cn: 【现代认知心理学】双进程认知理论（系统1直觉自动化 vs 系统2深思熟虑理性反思）
words.sentence: Dual-process cognitive models in behavioral psychology closely mirror Plato's ancient intuition about conflicting mental faculties.
words.trans: 行为心理学中的双进程认知模型，与柏拉图对相互冲突的心智机能的古老洞见高度契合。
words.speaker: Prof. Tamar Gendler
words.scene_desc: 现代神经科学映射
words.sentence_cn: 行为心理学中的双进程认知模型，与柏拉图关于心灵能力相互冲突的古老直觉高度吻合。
words.def_en: the theory that the mind uses two separate systems, one fast and intuitive, the other slow and deliberate

words.def_cn: 【情绪调节心理学】认知重评（通过改变对处境的解读来理性调控情绪反应）
words.sentence: Cognitive reappraisal allows the rational intellect to modulate intense emotional reactions before they lead to irrational actions.
words.trans: 认知重评使理性智力能够在强烈情绪反应演化为非理性行动之前对其加以调控疏导。
words.speaker: Prof. Tamar Gendler
words.scene_desc: 情绪调节与理性自律机制
words.sentence_cn: 认知重评让理性智识能够在强烈情绪反应导致不理性行为之前对其加以调节。
words.def_en: the mental process of changing how you interpret a situation to control your emotional response

words.def_cn: 【元伦理学】道德直觉主义（主张道德真理具有自明性并能为理性直觉直接把握）
words.sentence: Moral intuitionism holds that foundational moral truths are immediately evident to our intellectual perception without formal proof.
words.trans: 道德直觉主义主张，最基本的道德真理无须形式证明，便能够被我们智性的直觉所直接领悟自明。
words.speaker: Prof. Tamar Gendler
words.scene_desc: 直觉自明性讨论
words.sentence_cn: 道德直觉主义认为，根本性的道德真理无需形式证明，就能被我们的理智直觉直接把握。
words.def_en: the view that basic moral truths are known directly by intuition

words.def_cn: 【古希腊伦理基石】四主德（智慧 Phronesis、勇敢 Andreia、节制 Sophrosyne、正义 Dikaiosyne）
words.sentence: The cardinal virtues represent the four essential pillars supporting both an honorable life and a harmonious commonwealth.
words.trans: 四大基要主德代表着支撑起体面尊贵的人生与和谐繁荣之联邦共同体的四大基石。
words.speaker: Prof. Tamar Gendler
words.scene_desc: 古希腊伦理大厦四大立柱
words.sentence_cn: 四主德代表着支撑体面生活与和谐共同体的四大支柱。
words.def_en: the four most important qualities of good character in ancient Greek ethics

ep04.title: Justice: What's The Right Thing To Do? Episode 04: "THIS LAND IS MY LAND"
ep04.cn_title: 第 04 集：这片土地是我的 / 同意即正当吗

words.sentence: MICHAEL SANDEL: Today, we turn to the question of distributive justice.
words.sentence_cn: 迈克尔·桑德尔：今天，我们转向分配正义的问题。
words.speaker: Prof. Michael Sandel
words.why: distributive justice 是政治哲学核心术语，指资源分配的正义原则。
words.def_en: relating to how things like wealth or resources are shared among people
words.scene_desc: 哈佛《公正》课堂现场 · 时间戳 [00:29]

words.sentence: And what matters is that the hypothetical contract be carried out in an original position of equality, behind, what Rawls calls, the veil of ignorance.
words.sentence_cn: 关键在于，这个假设的契约要在一种平等的原初状态下订立，也就是在罗尔斯所说的“无知之幕”背后进行。
words.speaker: Prof. Michael Sandel
words.why: veil of ignorance 是罗尔斯正义论的关键概念，指无知之幕。
words.def_en: something that hides or covers what is true or real
words.scene_desc: 哈佛《公正》课堂现场 · 时间戳 [01:16]

words.sentence: And what matters is that the hypothetical contract be carried out in an original position of equality, behind, what Rawls calls, the veil of ignorance.
words.sentence_cn: 关键在于，这个假设的契约要在一种平等的原初状态下订立，也就是在罗尔斯所说的“无知之幕”背后进行。
words.speaker: Prof. Michael Sandel
words.why: 与 veil 构成无知之幕，是罗尔斯理论的核心假设。
words.def_en: the state of not knowing or not having information
words.scene_desc: 哈佛《公正》课堂现场 · 时间戳 [01:16]

words.sentence: And the reason is that, behind the veil of ignorance, everyone knows that, once the veil goes up and real life begins, we will each want to be respected with dignity.
words.sentence_cn: 原因在于，在无知之幕背后，每个人都知道，一旦无知之幕升起、现实生活开始，我们每个人都希望得到有尊严的对待。
words.speaker: Prof. Michael Sandel
words.why: 尊严是道德哲学核心概念，涉及人的内在价值与尊重。
words.def_en: the quality of deserving respect and being treated with honor
words.scene_desc: 哈佛《公正》课堂现场 · 时间戳 [02:13]

words.sentence: Even if we turn out to be a member of a minority, we don't want to be oppressed.
words.sentence_cn: 即使我们最终成为少数群体的一员，我们也不希望受压迫。
words.speaker: Prof. Michael Sandel
words.why: 受压迫是正义理论中讨论弱势群体与权利保障的关键词。
words.def_en: treated in a cruel and unfair way by people with power
words.scene_desc: 哈佛《公正》课堂现场 · 时间戳 [02:35]

words.sentence: And so, we would agree to reject utilitarianism and, instead, to adopt, as our first principle, equal basic liberties, fundamental rights to freedom of speech, freedom of assembly, religious liberty, freedom of conscience, and the like.
words.sentence_cn: 因此，我们会同意拒绝功利主义，转而采纳平等的基本自由作为我们的第一原则，即言论自由、集会自由、宗教自由、良心自由等基本权利。
words.speaker: Prof. Michael Sandel
words.why: 基本自由是罗尔斯第一正义原则的核心内容。
words.def_en: basic rights and freedoms that all people should have
words.scene_desc: 哈佛《公正》课堂现场 · 时间戳 [02:44]

words.sentence: And so, we would agree to reject utilitarianism and, instead, to adopt, as our first principle, equal basic liberties, fundamental rights to freedom of speech, freedom of assembly, religious liberty, freedom of conscience, and the like.
words.sentence_cn: 因此，我们会同意拒绝功利主义，转而采纳平等的基本自由作为我们的第一原则，即言论自由、集会自由、宗教自由、良心自由等基本权利。
words.speaker: Prof. Michael Sandel
words.why: 良心自由是基本自由之一，涉及道德与宗教自由。
words.def_en: an inner moral faculty enabling one to distinguish right from wrong
words.scene_desc: 哈佛《公正》课堂现场 · 时间戳 [02:44]

words.sentence: We wouldn't want to take the chance that we would wind up as members of an oppressed, or a despised, minority, with the majority tyrannizing over us.
words.sentence_cn: 我们不会愿意冒险让自己最终成为受压迫、受鄙视的少数群体的一员，任由多数人对我们施行暴政。
words.speaker: Prof. Michael Sandel
words.why: 暴政是政治哲学中讨论权力滥用与压迫的重要概念。
words.def_en: ruling over people in a cruel and oppressive way
words.scene_desc: 哈佛《公正》课堂现场 · 时间戳 [03:07]

words.sentence: Utilitarianism makes the mistake, Rawls writes, of forgetting, or, at least, not taking seriously, the distinction between persons.
words.sentence_cn: 罗尔斯写道，功利主义的错误在于忘记了，或者至少没有认真对待，人与人之间的分别。
words.speaker: Prof. Michael Sandel
words.why: 人的区分是罗尔斯批判功利主义的关键论点。
words.def_en: a clear difference made between two or more things
words.scene_desc: 哈佛《公正》课堂现场 · 时间戳 [03:31]

words.sentence: Second principle has to do with social and economic inequalities.
words.sentence_cn: 第二条原则涉及社会和经济的不平等。
words.speaker: Prof. Michael Sandel
words.why: 社会与经济不平等是分配正义的核心议题。
words.def_en: unfair differences in wealth, status, or opportunities
words.scene_desc: 哈佛《公正》课堂现场 · 时间戳 [04:02]

words.sentence: Remember, we don't know whether we're going to wind up being rich or poor, healthy or unhealthy. We don't know what kind of family we're going to come from, whether we're going to inherit millions or whether we will come from an impoverished family.
words.sentence_cn: 记住，我们不知道自己最终会变得富有还是贫穷，健康还是不健康。我们不知道自己会出身于什么样的家庭，是会继承数百万家产，还是来自一个贫困的家庭。
words.speaker: Prof. Michael Sandel
words.why: 贫困家庭是讨论分配正义时常见的背景因素。
words.def_en: very poor and lacking money or basic resources
words.scene_desc: 哈佛《公正》课堂现场 · 时间戳 [04:11]

words.sentence: Rawls calls it the difference principle.
words.sentence_cn: 罗尔斯称之为差别原则。
words.speaker: Prof. Michael Sandel
words.why: 差别原则是罗尔斯正义论的第二原则，核心术语。
words.def_en: the way in which two or more things are not the same
words.scene_desc: 哈佛《公正》课堂现场 · 时间戳 [05:06]

words.sentence: A principle that says, only those social and economic inequalities will be permitted that work to the benefit of the least-well off.
words.sentence_cn: 这条原则说的是，只有那些能让处境最差的人受益的社会和经济不平等，才会被允许。
words.speaker: Prof. Michael Sandel
words.why: 在正义原则中，允许何种不平等是关键论证环节。
words.def_en: to be officially allowed or accepted according to a rule or principle
words.scene_desc: 哈佛《公正》课堂现场 · 时间戳 [05:10]

words.sentence: Only if they were part of a system, those wage differentials, that actually work to the advantage of the least-well off.
words.sentence_cn: 只有当这些工资差异是一个体系的组成部分，而这个体系实际上有利于最弱势群体时，才行。
words.speaker: Prof. Michael Sandel
words.why: 工资差异是讨论经济不平等时的具体表现。
words.def_en: differences in the amount of pay people receive for similar work
words.scene_desc: 哈佛《公正》课堂现场 · 时间戳 [06:16]

words.sentence: Maybe it turns out that, as a practical matter, you have to provide incentives, to attract the right people to certain jobs.
words.sentence_cn: 也许事实证明，从实际角度出发，你必须提供激励，才能吸引合适的人去做某些工作。
words.speaker: Prof. Michael Sandel
words.why: 激励是论证差别原则时解释不平等如何惠及最差者的关键。
words.def_en: things that encourage people to do something or work harder
words.scene_desc: 哈佛《公正》课堂现场 · 时间戳 [06:29]

words.sentence: AUDIENCE: In that situation, I would say a merit-based one. One where I don't necessarily know, but I'd rather have a system that rewards me based on my efforts.
words.sentence_cn: 观众：在那种情况下，我会说选择一种基于优绩的制度。一种我未必了解的制度，但我宁愿要一个根据我的努力来奖励我的制度。
words.speaker: Prof. Michael Sandel
words.why: merit-based 是讨论分配正义时与平等相对的重要原则。
words.def_en: a good quality or achievement that deserves reward or recognition
words.scene_desc: 哈佛《公正》课堂现场 · 时间戳 [08:12]

words.sentence: It shouldn't be based on factors that are arbitrary, from a moral point of view.
words.sentence_cn: 它不应该建立在从道德角度看是任意的因素之上。
words.speaker: Prof. Michael Sandel
words.why: 道德上任意是罗尔斯论证不应基于无法掌控因素的核心概念。
words.def_en: based on random choice or personal whim rather than reason or system
words.scene_desc: 哈佛《公正》课堂现场 · 时间戳 [12:13]

words.sentence: He begins with the theory of justice that most everyone these days would reject, a feudal aristocracy.
words.sentence_cn: 他从如今几乎人人都会拒绝的一种正义理论开始，那就是封建贵族统治。
words.speaker: Prof. Michael Sandel
words.why: 封建贵族制是罗尔斯讨论正义理论时首先批判的分配制度。
words.def_en: a social class of people with high rank and special privileges

words.sentence: He begins with the theory of justice that most everyone these days would reject, a feudal aristocracy.
words.sentence_cn: 他从如今几乎人人都会拒绝的一种正义理论开始，那就是封建贵族统治。
words.speaker: Prof. Michael Sandel
words.why: 封建贵族制是罗尔斯正义理论的历史对照。
words.def_en: a. of or relating to or characteristic of feudalism
words.scene_desc: 哈佛《公正》课堂现场 · 时间戳 [12:30]

words.sentence: What's wrong with the allocation of life prospects in a feudal aristocracy?
words.sentence_cn: 在封建贵族统治下，对人生前景的分配有什么问题？
words.speaker: Prof. Michael Sandel
words.why: 生活前景是分配正义讨论中衡量机会与结果的重要概念。
words.def_en: the chances or possibilities that someone will have for success or a good life in the future
words.scene_desc: 哈佛《公正》课堂现场 · 时间戳 [12:41]

words.sentence: Well, the thing that's obviously wrong about it is that people's life prospects are determined by the accident of birth-- are you born to a noble family or to the family of peasants and serfs-- and that's it.
words.sentence_cn: 嗯，它明显的问题在于，人们的生活前景是由出生的偶然性决定的——你是出生在贵族家庭，还是出生在农民和农奴的家庭——就是这样。
words.speaker: Prof. Michael Sandel
words.why: 出生偶然是罗尔斯论证道德任意性的关键例子。
words.def_en: a chance event that happens without being planned or intended
words.scene_desc: 哈佛《公正》课堂现场 · 时间戳 [12:50]

words.sentence: And so, that objection to a feudal aristocracy leads, and historically has led, people to say, careers should be open to talents.
words.sentence_cn: 因此，对封建贵族的这种反对意见导致——而且在历史上确实导致了——人们说，职业应当向有才能的人开放。
words.speaker: Prof. Michael Sandel
words.why: 才能是讨论分配正义时关于应得与道德任意性的核心概念。
words.def_en: natural abilities or skills that make someone suitable for a particular role
words.scene_desc: 哈佛《公正》课堂现场 · 时间戳 [13:16]

words.sentence: There should be formal equality of opportunity, regardless of the accident of birth.
words.sentence_cn: 应当有形式上的机会平等，不论出生的偶然性如何。
words.speaker: Prof. Michael Sandel
words.why: 形式机会平等是罗尔斯讨论的正义原则之一。
words.def_en: following official or accepted rules and procedures
words.scene_desc: 哈佛《公正》课堂现场 · 时间戳 [13:28]

words.sentence: There should be formal equality of opportunity, regardless of the accident of birth.
words.sentence_cn: 应当有形式上的机会平等，不论出生的偶然性如何。
words.speaker: Prof. Michael Sandel
words.why: 机会平等是分配正义的核心议题。
words.def_en: a situation that makes it possible for someone to do something they want
words.scene_desc: 哈佛《公正》课堂现场 · 时间戳 [13:28]

words.sentence: Every person should be free to strive, to work, to apply for any job in the society.
words.sentence_cn: 每个人都应当可以自由地努力、工作、申请社会中的任何职位。
words.speaker: Prof. Michael Sandel
words.why: 奋斗是讨论个人努力与应得时的重要动词。
words.def_en: to try very hard to achieve something difficult
words.scene_desc: 哈佛《公正》课堂现场 · 时间戳 [13:34]

words.sentence: Every person should be free to strive, to work, to apply for any job in the society.
words.sentence_cn: 每个人都应当可以自由地努力、工作、申请社会中的任何职位。
words.speaker: Prof. Michael Sandel
words.why: 申请工作是形式机会平等的具体体现。
words.def_en: to make a formal request for a job, position, or opportunity
words.scene_desc: 哈佛《公正》课堂现场 · 时间戳 [13:34]

words.sentence: Only if they were part of a system, those wage differentials, that actually work to the advantage of the least-well off.
words.sentence_cn: 只有当这些工资差异是一个体系的组成部分，而这个体系实际上有利于最弱势群体时，才行。
words.speaker: Prof. Michael Sandel
words.why: 优势是讨论社会与经济不平等时常用的核心词。
words.def_en: something that helps you or puts you in a better position
words.scene_desc: 哈佛《公正》课堂现场 · 时间戳 [06:16]

words.sentence: MICHAEL SANDEL: Kate, you suspect that the ability to get into top schools may largely depend on coming from an affluent family, having a favorable family background, social, cultural, economic advantages, and so on?
words.sentence_cn: 迈克尔·桑德尔：凯特，你觉得能不能进顶尖学校，很大程度上可能取决于你是不是来自富裕家庭，有没有好的家庭背景，以及社会、文化、经济上的种种优势等等？
words.speaker: Prof. Michael Sandel
words.why: 社会、文化、经济优势是影响机会平等的重要因素。
words.def_en: conditions that give you a better chance to succeed
words.scene_desc: 哈佛《公正》课堂现场 · 时间戳 [09:51]

words.sentence: MICHAEL SANDEL: Kate, you suspect that the ability to get into top schools may largely depend on coming from an affluent family, having a favorable family background, social, cultural, economic advantages, and so on?
words.sentence_cn: 迈克尔·桑德尔：凯特，你觉得能不能进顶尖学校，很大程度上可能取决于你是不是来自富裕家庭，有没有好的家庭背景，以及社会、文化、经济上的种种优势等等？
words.speaker: Prof. Michael Sandel
words.why: 富裕家庭背景是讨论教育机会不平等时的关键因素。
words.def_en: having a lot of money and a good standard of living
words.scene_desc: 哈佛《公正》课堂现场 · 时间戳 [09:51]

words.sentence: MICHAEL SANDEL: Kate, you suspect that the ability to get into top schools may largely depend on coming from an affluent family, having a favorable family background, social, cultural, economic advantages, and so on?
words.sentence_cn: 迈克尔·桑德尔：凯特，你觉得能不能进顶尖学校，很大程度上可能取决于你是不是来自富裕家庭，有没有好的家庭背景，以及社会、文化、经济上的种种优势等等？
words.speaker: Prof. Michael Sandel
words.why: 家庭背景是影响分配正义讨论中机会平等的因素。
words.def_en: the family and social situation a person comes from
words.scene_desc: 哈佛《公正》课堂现场 · 时间戳 [09:51]

words.sentence: MICHAEL SANDEL: Someone did a study of the 146 selective colleges and universities in the United States, and they looked at the students in those colleges and universities to try to find out what their background was, their economic background.
words.sentence_cn: 迈克尔·桑德尔：有人对美国146所择优录取的高校做了一项研究，他们调查了这些高校的学生，试图弄清他们的背景，他们的经济背景。
words.speaker: Prof. Michael Sandel
words.why: 选择性大学是讨论教育机会分配时的具体例子。
words.def_en: admitting only a limited number of applicants chosen for high standards
words.scene_desc: 哈佛《公正》课堂现场 · 时间戳 [10:17]

words.sentence: What percentage do you think come from the bottom quarter of the income scale?
words.sentence_cn: 你们觉得来自收入等级最低四分之一家庭的学生占多大百分比？
words.speaker: Prof. Michael Sandel
words.why: 百分比是量化社会不平等时常用的统计术语。
words.def_en: an amount expressed as a number out of a hundred
words.scene_desc: 哈佛《公正》课堂现场 · 时间戳 [10:37]

words.sentence: for all of us, despite the fact that some of us may be in the second percentile and some may be in the 98th percentile.
words.sentence_cn: 对我们所有人来说，尽管我们中有些人可能处于第二个百分位，有些人可能处于第九十八个百分位。
words.speaker: Prof. Michael Sandel
words.why: 百分位是描述收入或成绩分布时常用的统计概念。
words.def_en: a number that shows what position someone has in a group of a hundred
words.scene_desc: 哈佛《公正》课堂现场 · 时间戳 [09:12]

words.sentence: What percentage do you think come from the bottom quarter of the income scale?
words.sentence_cn: 你们觉得来自收入等级最低四分之一家庭的学生占多大百分比？
words.speaker: Prof. Michael Sandel
words.why: 收入等级是讨论分配正义时衡量不平等的尺度。
words.def_en: a graduated system of levels used to measure or rank something
words.scene_desc: 哈佛《公正》课堂现场 · 时间戳 [10:37]

words.sentence: Your argument depends upon us believing that we would argue and set policy, or justice, from a bottom, for the disadvantaged.
words.sentence_cn: 你的论证取决于我们相信，我们会从底层、为弱势群体来论证和制定政策或正义原则。
words.speaker: Prof. Michael Sandel
words.why: 政策是讨论正义原则如何应用于社会时的核心词。
words.def_en: a plan or set of rules that a group or government follows
words.scene_desc: 哈佛《公正》课堂现场 · 时间戳 [07:18]

words.sentence: Rawls illustrates this by considering several rival theories of justice.
words.sentence_cn: 罗尔斯通过考察几种相互竞争的正义理论来阐明这一点。
words.speaker: Prof. Michael Sandel
words.why: 正义理论是政治哲学中比较和评估不同分配方案的核心。
words.def_en: sets of ideas or principles intended to explain something
words.scene_desc: 哈佛《公正》课堂现场 · 时间戳 [12:20]

words.sentence: By trying to make sense of why he thinks that principles of justice are best derived from a hypothetical contract.
words.sentence_cn: 我们上次试着理解了他为什么认为正义原则最好是从一个假设的契约中推导出来的。
words.speaker: Prof. Michael Sandel
words.why: 假设契约是罗尔斯论证正义原则来源的关键概念。
words.def_en: a binding arrangement between parties that establishes their mutual obligations
words.scene_desc: 哈佛《公正》课堂现场 · 时间戳 [00:58]

words.def_cn: 精英统治的；贤能政治的
words.sentence: And that's, really, the system that Mike was advocating, earlier on, what we might call a merit-based system, a meritocratic system.
words.sentence_cn: 而这实际上就是迈克之前所主张的制度，我们可以称之为基于才能的制度，一种贤能体制。
words.speaker: Prof. Michael Sandel
words.why: 罗尔斯论证中关键的制度类型，与公平机会原则紧密相关。
words.def_en: describing a system where success depends on ability and effort rather than wealth or social class
words.scene_desc: 哈佛《公正》课堂现场 · 时间戳 [15:03]

words.sentence: In a fair meritocracy, the society sets up institutions to bring everyone to the same starting point before the race begins.
words.sentence_cn: 在一个公平的贤能体制中，社会建立各种制度，在比赛开始前把每个人都带到同一起点。
words.speaker: Prof. Michael Sandel
words.why: 政治哲学核心概念，指以才能和努力分配地位的制度。
words.def_en: a system where people get power or success because of ability, not money or family
words.scene_desc: 哈佛《公正》课堂现场 · 时间戳 [15:12]

words.sentence: Even that, he says, doesn't go far enough in remedying, or addressing, the moral arbitrariness of the natural lottery.
words.sentence_cn: 他说，即便如此，也不足以纠正或应对天赋分配在道德上的任意性。
words.speaker: Prof. Michael Sandel
words.why: 罗尔斯道德任意性论证的核心名词，指自然与社会偶然性的道德地位。
words.def_en: the quality of being based on random choice or personal whim rather than reason
words.scene_desc: 哈佛《公正》课堂现场 · 时间戳 [15:55]

words.sentence: So Rawls says, even the principle of meritocracy, where you bring everyone to the same starting point, may eliminate the influence of social contingencies.
words.sentence_cn: 所以罗尔斯说，即便是贤能体制的原则——把每个人都带到同一起点——也许能消除社会偶然性的影响。
words.speaker: Prof. Michael Sandel
words.why: 指社会偶然性，是罗尔斯论证中需要消除的道德任意因素。
words.def_en: factors that are not planned or controlled and may affect outcomes
words.scene_desc: 哈佛《公正》课堂现场 · 时间戳 [16:41]

words.sentence: But even with formal equality of opportunity, the libertarian conception doesn't extend that, doesn't extend its insight, far enough.
words.sentence_cn: 但即便有了形式上的机会平等，自由至上主义的观念也没有把这一点、没有把它的洞见推得足够远。
words.speaker: Prof. Michael Sandel
words.why: 政治哲学中常指对正义、自由等概念的特定理解。
words.def_en: an idea or understanding of what something is or should be
words.scene_desc: 哈佛《公正》课堂现场 · 时间戳 [14:09]

words.sentence: But what you do is you change the terms on which people are entitled to the fruits of the exercise of those talents.
words.sentence_cn: 但你要做的是改变人们有权享有这些才能施展成果的条件。
words.speaker: Prof. Michael Sandel
words.why: 涉及分配正义中权利与应得的核心概念。
words.def_en: having the right to have or receive something
words.scene_desc: 哈佛《公正》课堂现场 · 时间戳 [18:09]

words.sentence: MICHAEL SANDEL: Kate, does it bother you-- and, Mike, does it bother you-- that, in a meritocratic system, even with fair equality of opportunity, people get ahead, people get rewards that they don't deserve, simply because they happen to be naturally gifted?
words.sentence_cn: 迈克尔·桑德尔：凯特，在一种精英体制中，即便有公平的机会平等，人们仍然会出人头地，会得到他们本不应得的回报，仅仅因为他们碰巧天赋异禀——这让你困扰吗？迈克，这让你困扰吗？
words.speaker: Prof. Michael Sandel
words.why: 道德哲学中应得概念的核心动词，与正义理论直接相关。
words.def_en: to have earned something as a result of your actions or qualities
words.scene_desc: 哈佛《公正》课堂现场 · 时间戳 [20:34]

words.sentence: And unlike- MICHAEL SANDEL: Because it would reduce incentives, is that why? AUDIENCE: It would reduce incentives, yeah. MICHAEL SANDEL: Mike, what do you say? AUDIENCE: We're all sitting in this room, and we have undeserved-- we have undeserved glory of some sort.
words.sentence_cn: 而且不像——迈克尔·桑德尔：是因为这会削弱激励，是这个原因吗？观众：是会削弱激励，对。迈克尔·桑德尔：迈克，你怎么看？观众：我们所有人都坐在这间教室里，我们拥有某种不应得的——我们拥有某种不应得的荣耀。
words.speaker: Prof. Michael Sandel
words.why: 描述才能与奖励之间道德断裂的关键形容词。
words.def_en: s. not deserved or earned
words.scene_desc: 哈佛《公正》课堂现场 · 时间戳 [21:04]

words.sentence: From a moral point of view, such as whether you got a good education or not, whether you grew up in a family that supported you and developed in you a work ethic and gave you the opportunities.
words.sentence_cn: 从道德角度来看，比如你是否接受了良好的教育，是否在一个支持你的家庭中长大，这个家庭培养了你勤奋工作的品德，并给了你各种机会。
words.speaker: Prof. Michael Sandel
words.why: 伦理学术语，如工作伦理，涉及道德品质与行为规范。
words.def_en: a belief in the value of hard work and diligence
words.scene_desc: 哈佛《公正》课堂现场 · 时间戳 [14:43]

words.sentence: But Rawls says, you don't have to have a kind of leveling equality, if you want to go beyond a meritocratic conception.
words.sentence_cn: 但罗尔斯说，如果你想超越贤能政治的观念，你不必非得搞一种拉平的平等。
words.speaker: Prof. Michael Sandel
words.why: 指一种极端平等主义，消除一切差异。
words.def_en: reducing differences in a way that seems to lower standards
words.scene_desc: 哈佛《公正》课堂现场 · 时间戳 [17:50]

words.sentence: You permit, you even encourage, those who may be gifted to exercise their talents.
words.sentence_cn: 你允许、甚至鼓励那些可能有天赋的人施展他们的才能。
words.speaker: Prof. Michael Sandel
words.why: 描述自然才能的拥有者，涉及应得与道德任意性。
words.def_en: having a natural ability or talent for something
words.scene_desc: 哈佛《公正》课堂现场 · 时间戳 [17:59]

words.sentence: And upbringing, "but it still permits the distribution of wealth and income to be determined by the natural distribution of abilities and talents."
words.sentence_cn: 还有教养，“但它仍然允许财富和收入的分配由能力和天赋的自然分布来决定。”
words.speaker: Prof. Michael Sandel
words.why: 与talents并列，指自然能力的分配。
words.def_en: the mental or physical powers that enable someone to perform tasks
words.scene_desc: 哈佛《公正》课堂现场 · 时间戳 [16:52]

words.sentence: You establish a principle that says people may benefit from their good fortune. from their luck in the genetic lottery, but only on terms that work to the advantage of the least-well off.
words.sentence_cn: 你确立一条原则，规定人们可以从他们的好运中获益——从他们在基因彩票中的运气中获益，但只能按照有利于最不幸者的条件来获益。
words.speaker: Prof. Michael Sandel
words.why: 指好运或财富，在罗尔斯论证中与道德应得相对。
words.def_en: chance or luck, especially good luck that brings success
words.scene_desc: 哈佛《公正》课堂现场 · 时间戳 [18:21]

words.sentence: You establish a principle that says people may benefit from their good fortune. from their luck in the genetic lottery, but only on terms that work to the advantage of the least-well off.
words.sentence_cn: 你确立一条原则，规定人们可以从他们的好运中获益——从他们在基因彩票中的运气中获益，但只能按照有利于最不幸者的条件来获益。
words.speaker: Prof. Michael Sandel
words.why: 与fortune同义，强调分配中的偶然因素。
words.def_en: the force that causes things to happen to someone by chance rather than through effort
words.scene_desc: 哈佛《公正》课堂现场 · 时间戳 [18:21]

words.sentence: Even the effort that some people expend-- conscientious striving, the work ethic-- Even effort depends a lot on fortunate family circumstances, for which you, we, can claim no credit.
words.sentence_cn: 即便是某些人所付出的努力——认真的奋斗、敬业精神——就连努力也在很大程度上取决于幸运的家庭环境，对此你、我们，都谈不上有什么功劳。
words.speaker: Prof. Michael Sandel
words.why: 描述家庭环境等偶然优势，影响努力与应得。
words.def_en: having good luck or favorable circumstances
words.scene_desc: 哈佛《公正》课堂现场 · 时间戳 [22:27]

words.sentence: But is it their doing, that they happen to be blessed with the athletic prowess to run fast?
words.sentence_cn: 但跑得快这种运动天赋，是他们自己争取来的吗？
words.speaker: Prof. Michael Sandel
words.why: 常用于描述天赋，暗示其非个人功劳。

words.sentence: The reason the individual is sacred or the bearer of rights, according to Kant, doesn't stem from the idea that we own ourselves, but instead from the idea that we are all rational beings.
words.sentence_cn: 按照康德的说法，个人之所以神圣、之所以是权利的承载者，并不是源于我们拥有自己这一观念，而是源于我们都是理性存在者这一观念。
words.speaker: Prof. Michael Sandel
words.why: 康德伦理学的核心概念，指人区别于动物的理性能力，是道德法则的来源。
words.def_en: the power of the mind to think, understand, and form judgments logically
words.scene_desc: 哈佛《公正》课堂现场 · 时间戳 [03:01]

words.sentence: What makes an action morally worthy has to do with the motive, with the quality of the will, with the intention for which the act is done.
words.sentence_cn: 一个行为之所以具有道德价值，与动机有关，与意志的品质有关，与做出该行为所出于的意图有关。
words.speaker: Prof. Michael Sandel
words.why: 康德道德哲学的关键术语，道德价值取决于动机而非结果。
words.def_en: the reason or intention that makes someone do something
words.scene_desc: 哈佛《公正》课堂现场 · 时间戳 [13:41]

words.sentence: The idea is that the motive confers the moral worth on an action, and the only kind of motive that can confer moral worth on an action is the motive of duty.
words.sentence_cn: 这个观点是：动机赋予行为以道德价值，而唯一能赋予行为道德价值的动机，就是义务的动机。
words.speaker: Prof. Michael Sandel
words.why: 康德伦理学的核心概念，只有出于义务的动机才赋予行为道德价值。
words.def_en: a moral or legal obligation to do something
words.scene_desc: 哈佛《公正》课堂现场 · 时间戳 [14:53]

words.sentence: Kant's answer: to act freely is to act autonomously, and to act autonomously is to act according to a law that I give myself.
words.sentence_cn: 康德的回答是：自由地行动就是自主地行动，而自主地行动就是按照我自己给自己制定的法则来行动。
words.speaker: Prof. Michael Sandel
words.why: 康德自由观的核心，指按照自己给自己立的法则行动。
words.def_en: in a way that involves making one's own choices and acting freely
words.scene_desc: 哈佛《公正》课堂现场 · 时间戳 [07:37]

words.def_cn: 他律地；受外部法则支配地
words.sentence: When I act heteronomously, I'm acting according to an inclination or a desire that I haven't chosen for myself.
words.sentence_cn: 当我他律地行动时，我是按照一种我并未为自己选择的倾向或欲望在行动。
words.speaker: Prof. Michael Sandel
words.why: 与自律相对，指受外部倾向或欲望支配而行动，是康德道德哲学的关键对立概念。
words.def_en: in a way that is controlled by outside forces rather than your own will
words.scene_desc: 哈佛《公正》课堂现场 · 时间戳 [08:30]

words.sentence: Now what is the opposite? What is the opposite of autonomy?
words.sentence_cn: 那么，它的对立面是什么？自律的对立面是什么？
words.speaker: Prof. Michael Sandel
words.why: 康德自由观的核心术语，指意志自己为自己立法。
words.def_en: the state of being self-governing and making one's own decisions
words.scene_desc: 哈佛《公正》课堂现场 · 时间戳 [08:07]

words.sentence: When I act heteronomously, I'm acting according to an inclination or a desire that I haven't chosen for myself.
words.sentence_cn: 当我他律地行动时，我是按照一种我并未为自己选择的倾向或欲望在行动。
words.speaker: Prof. Michael Sandel
words.why: 康德哲学中与义务相对的概念，指基于感性欲望的行动倾向。
words.def_en: a natural tendency or desire to act in a certain way
words.scene_desc: 哈佛《公正》课堂现场 · 时间戳 [08:30]

words.sentence: Would be upholding justice and rights and respect for persons for the wrong reason, for a purely contingent reason, for an instrumental reason.
words.sentence_cn: 那将是为了错误的理由、纯粹偶然的理由、工具性的理由来维护正义、权利和对人的尊重。
words.speaker: Prof. Michael Sandel
words.why: 指仅把人当作手段而非目的，是康德所批判的功利主义态度。
words.def_en: used as a means to achieve a further end
words.scene_desc: 哈佛《公正》课堂现场 · 时间戳 [12:17]

words.sentence: Would be upholding justice and rights and respect for persons for the wrong reason, for a purely contingent reason, for an instrumental reason.
words.sentence_cn: 那将是为了错误的理由、纯粹偶然的理由、工具性的理由来维护正义、权利和对人的尊重。
words.speaker: Prof. Michael Sandel
words.why: 学术论证中表示非必然、依赖外部条件的，此处指功利主义理由的偶然性。
words.def_en: depending on something else that may or may not happen
words.scene_desc: 哈佛《公正》课堂现场 · 时间戳 [12:17]

words.sentence: Insofar as we act on inclination or pursue pleasure we fact as means to the realization of ends given outside us.
words.sentence_cn: 只要我们按倾向行动或追求快乐，我们就是作为实现外在于我们的目的的手段而行动。
words.speaker: Prof. Michael Sandel
words.why: 学术论证中用于限定条件的常用连接词，影响听力理解。
words.def_en: to the degree or extent that a particular situation applies
words.scene_desc: 哈佛《公正》课堂现场 · 时间戳 [10:13]

words.sentence: But this isn't Kant's idea of freedom. Kant has a more stringent, demanding notion of what it means to be free, and though stringent and demanding, if you think it through, it's actually pretty persuasive.
words.sentence_cn: 但这不是康德对自由的理解。康德对自由的含义有一个更严格、更苛刻的概念，尽管严格而苛刻，但如果你仔细想想，它其实相当有说服力。
words.speaker: Prof. Michael Sandel
words.why: 描述康德自由观和道德观的严格性，是学术高频形容词。
words.def_en: very strict and demanding, allowing no exceptions
words.scene_desc: 哈佛《公正》课堂现场 · 时间戳 [05:13]

words.sentence: I want to acknowledge even before we start that Kant is a difficult thinker, but it's important to try to figure out what he's saying because what this book is about is, well, it's about what the supreme principle of morality is.
words.sentence_cn: 我想在开始之前先说明，康德是一位很难理解的思想家，但努力弄懂他在说什么很重要，因为这本书讲的是，嗯，讲的是道德的最高原则是什么。
words.speaker: Prof. Michael Sandel
words.why: 用于描述道德的最高原则，是学术文本中的常用词。
words.def_en: having the highest rank or authority and above all others
words.scene_desc: 哈佛《公正》课堂现场 · 时间戳 [02:02]

words.sentence: The idea is that the motive confers the moral worth on an action, and the only kind of motive that can confer moral worth on an action is the motive of duty.
words.sentence_cn: 这个观点是：动机赋予行为以道德价值，而唯一能赋予行为道德价值的动机，就是义务的动机。
words.speaker: Prof. Michael Sandel
words.why: 学术论证中表示赋予某种属性，此处指动机赋予行为道德价值。
words.def_en: to give a quality or value to something
words.scene_desc: 哈佛《公正》课堂现场 · 时间戳 [14:53]

words.sentence: What does Kant say? What makes an action morally worthy consists not in the consequences or in the results that flow from it.
words.sentence_cn: 康德怎么说？一个行为之所以具有道德价值，并不在于它的后果或由它产生的结果。
words.speaker: Prof. Michael Sandel
words.why: 与道德价值相关，常用于学术讨论中表示值得的。
words.def_en: deserving praise or respect because of good qualities or actions
words.scene_desc: 哈佛《公正》课堂现场 · 时间戳 [13:28]

words.sentence: And so for any action to be morally good, it's not enough that it should conform to the moral law, it must also be done for the sake of the moral law.
words.sentence_cn: 因此，任何行为要具有道德上的善，仅仅符合道德法则是不够的，它还必须是为了道德法则本身而做的。
words.speaker: Prof. Michael Sandel
words.why: 学术常用词，此处指行为符合道德法则。
words.def_en: to act in accordance with a rule or standard
words.scene_desc: 哈佛《公正》课堂现场 · 时间戳 [14:38]

words.sentence: Now why is autonomy the opposite of the acting heteronomously or according to the dictates of nature?
words.sentence_cn: 那么，为什么自律是与他律地行动、或按自然的命令行动相对立的呢？
words.speaker: Prof. Michael Sandel
words.why: 学术文本中表示权威性指令，此处指自然法则的支配。
words.def_en: rules or orders that tell someone what they must do
words.scene_desc: 哈佛《公正》课堂现场 · 时间戳 [08:55]

words.sentence: It makes us something more than just physical creatures with appetites. Now.
words.sentence_cn: 它使我们不仅仅是具有欲望的肉体存在。
words.speaker: Prof. Michael Sandel
words.why: 在康德哲学中指感性欲望，与理性相对。
words.def_en: natural desires or urges, especially for food, pleasure, or satisfaction
words.scene_desc: 哈佛《公正》课堂现场 · 时间戳 [04:47]

words.sentence: We're really acting as the slaves of those appetites and impulses.
words.sentence_cn: 我们实际上沦为那些欲望和冲动的奴隶。
words.speaker: Prof. Michael Sandel
words.why: 指非理性的内在驱动力，是康德所反对的行动依据。
words.def_en: sudden strong urges to act without thinking about consequences
words.scene_desc: 哈佛《公正》课堂现场 · 时间戳 [05:51]

words.sentence: We are instruments rather than authors of the purposes we pursue.
words.sentence_cn: 我们是我们所追求的目的的工具，而不是这些目的的创造者。
words.speaker: Prof. Michael Sandel
words.why: 学术常用词，此处指行为所追求的目标。
words.def_en: the aims or goals that someone tries to achieve
words.scene_desc: 哈佛《公正》课堂现场 · 时间戳 [10:24]

words.sentence: who offers a different account of why we have a categorical duty to respect the dignity of persons and not to use people as means merely, even for good ends.
words.sentence_cn: 他给出了另一种解释，说明为什么我们负有绝对的义务去尊重人的尊严，不把人仅仅当作手段，即便为了好的目的也不行。
words.speaker: Prof. Michael Sandel
words.why: 在康德名言中用于强调不能仅仅把人当作手段。
words.def_en: only, and nothing more than that
words.scene_desc: 哈佛《公正》课堂现场 · 时间戳 [00:41]

words.sentence: Would be upholding justice and rights and respect for persons for the wrong reason, for a purely contingent reason, for an instrumental reason.
words.sentence_cn: 那将是为了错误的理由、纯粹偶然的理由、工具性的理由来维护正义、权利和对人的尊重。
words.speaker: Prof. Michael Sandel
words.why: 学术常用副词，用于强调理由的纯粹性。
words.def_en: entirely, with no other element or influence involved
words.scene_desc: 哈佛《公正》课堂现场 · 时间戳 [12:17]

words.sentence: Even if by its utmost effort a good will accomplishes nothing, it would still shine like a jewel for its own sake as something which has its full value in itself.
words.sentence_cn: 即使一个善良意志竭尽全力却一事无成，它仍然会因其自身之故如宝石般闪耀，因为它本身就有充分的价值。
words.speaker: Prof. Michael Sandel
words.why: 固定短语 for the sake of，表示为了……的目的，是学术文本中的常见表达。
words.def_en: a purpose or benefit that something is done to achieve
words.scene_desc: 哈佛《公正》课堂现场 · 时间戳 [14:27]

words.sentence: And a few years later, Kant wrote The Groundwork for the Metaphysics of Morals, which we read in this course.
words.sentence_cn: 几年后，康德写下了《道德形而上学基础》，这本书我们在这门课上会读到。
words.speaker: Prof. Michael Sandel
words.why: 康德著作名，但作为普通词表示基础，具有学术价值。
words.def_en: preliminary work that forms the basis for later development
words.scene_desc: 哈佛《公正》课堂现场 · 时间戳 [01:52]

words.sentence: And a few years later, Kant wrote The Groundwork for the Metaphysics of Morals, which we read in this course.
words.sentence_cn: 几年后，康德写下了《道德形而上学基础》，这本书我们在这门课上会读到。
words.speaker: Prof. Michael Sandel
words.why: 道德哲学的核心术语，指道德原则或规范。
words.def_en: principles concerning right and wrong conduct
words.scene_desc: 哈佛《公正》课堂现场 · 时间戳 [01:52]

words.sentence: But this isn't Kant's idea of freedom. Kant has a more stringent, demanding notion of what it means to be free, and though stringent and demanding, if you think it through, it's actually pretty persuasive.
words.sentence_cn: 但这不是康德对自由的理解。康德对自由的含义有一个更严格、更苛刻的概念，尽管严格而苛刻，但如果你仔细想想，它其实相当有说服力。
words.speaker: Prof. Michael Sandel
words.why: 学术常用词，指对某事物的理解或看法。
words.def_en: an idea, belief, or understanding of something
words.scene_desc: 哈佛《公正》课堂现场 · 时间戳 [05:13]

words.sentence: Now, this capacity for reason and freedom isn't the only capacity we have. We also have the capacity for pain and pleasure, for suffering and satisfaction.
words.sentence_cn: 那么，这种理性和自由的能力并不是我们唯一的能力。我们还有感受痛苦和快乐、遭受苦难和获得满足的能力。
words.speaker: Prof. Michael Sandel
words.why: 学术高频词，指人的理性或感性能力。
words.def_en: the ability or power to do something or to feel something
words.scene_desc: 哈佛《公正》课堂现场 · 时间戳 [03:45]

words.sentence: We're all rational beings, which simply means that we are beings who are capable of reason.
words.sentence_cn: 我们都是理性存在者，这不过是说，我们是有能力运用理性的存在者。
words.speaker: Prof. Michael Sandel
words.why: 学术常用形容词，用于描述理性存在者的能力。
words.def_en: having the ability or power to do something
words.scene_desc: 哈佛《公正》课堂现场 · 时间戳 [03:21]

words.sentence: We're also autonomous beings, which is to say that we are beings capable of acting and choosing freely.
words.sentence_cn: 我们也是自主的存在，也就是说，我们是有能力自由行动和自由选择的存在。
words.speaker: Prof. Michael Sandel
words.why: 康德哲学的核心形容词，描述能够自主行动的存在者。
words.def_en: able to make one's own decisions and act freely without external control
words.scene_desc: 哈佛《公正》课堂现场 · 时间戳 [03:31]

words.sentence: We're also autonomous beings, which is to say that we are beings capable of acting and choosing freely.
words.sentence_cn: 我们也是自主的存在，也就是说，我们是有能力自由行动和自由选择的存在。
words.speaker: Prof. Michael Sandel
words.why: 与自由概念相关，是理解康德自由观的关键副词。
words.def_en: in a way that shows you are not controlled by anyone else
words.scene_desc: 哈佛《公正》课堂现场 · 时间戳 [03:31]

words.sentence: Kant rejects utilitarianism. He thinks that the individual person, all human beings, have a certain dignity that commands our respect.
words.sentence_cn: 康德拒绝功利主义。他认为个人，所有人类，都拥有某种尊严，这种尊严要求我们予以尊重。
words.speaker: Prof. Michael Sandel
words.why: 康德道德哲学的核心概念，指对他人尊严的尊重。
words.def_en: the honor and consideration that every person deserves because of their inherent worth
words.scene_desc: 哈佛《公正》课堂现场 · 时间戳 [02:38]

words.sentence: Respecting human dignity means regarding persons not just as means but also as ends in them.
words.sentence_cn: 尊重人的尊严，意味着要把人不仅仅当作手段，也要把他们当作目的本身。
words.speaker: Prof. Michael Sandel
words.why: 尊重概念的具体运用，强调把人当作目的。
words.def_en: showing regard for the rights and dignity of others
words.scene_desc: 哈佛《公正》课堂现场 · 时间戳 [11:11]

words.sentence: Even if by its utmost effort a good will accomplishes nothing, it would still shine like a jewel for its own sake as something which has its full value in itself.
words.sentence_cn: 即使一个善良意志竭尽全力却一事无成，它仍然会因其自身之故如宝石般闪耀，因为它本身就有充分的价值。
words.speaker: Prof. Michael Sandel
words.why: 道德哲学的核心概念，指事物本身的内在价值。
words.def_en: the worth of something considered in itself
words.scene_desc: 哈佛《公正》课堂现场 · 时间戳 [14:27]

words.sentence: Respecting human dignity means regarding persons not just as means but also as ends in them.
words.sentence_cn: 尊重人的尊严，意味着要把人不仅仅当作手段，也要把他们当作目的本身。
words.speaker: Prof. Michael Sandel
words.why: 康德伦理学核心术语，指人作为目的自身。
words.def_en: goals or purposes valued for their own sake, not as means to something else
words.scene_desc: 哈佛《公正》课堂现场 · 时间戳 [11:11]

words.sentence: Respecting human dignity means regarding persons not just as means but also as ends in them.
words.sentence_cn: 尊重人的尊严，意味着要把人不仅仅当作手段，也要把他们当作目的本身。
words.speaker: Prof. Michael Sandel
words.why: 道德哲学中特指具有理性与尊严的个体。
words.def_en: human beings, especially when considered as having rights, duties, and dignity
words.scene_desc: 哈佛《公正》课堂现场 · 时间戳 [11:11]

words.sentence: This capacity to act freely, Kant tells us, is what gives human life its special dignity.
words.sentence_cn: 康德告诉我们，正是这种自由行动的能力赋予了人类生活以特殊的尊严。
words.speaker: Prof. Michael Sandel
words.why: 学术常用词，用于讨论人类生命与尊严。
words.def_en: relating to or characteristic of people
words.scene_desc: 哈佛《公正》课堂现场 · 时间戳 [11:03]

words.sentence: Kant rejects utilitarianism. He thinks that the individual person, all human beings, have a certain dignity that commands our respect.
words.sentence_cn: 康德拒绝功利主义。他认为个人，所有人类，都拥有某种尊严，这种尊严要求我们予以尊重。
words.speaker: Prof. Michael Sandel
words.why: 哲学中特指理性存在者，是康德伦理学的核心概念。
words.def_en: creatures that exist, especially those able to reason or feel
words.scene_desc: 哈佛《公正》课堂现场 · 时间戳 [02:38]

words.sentence: Kant's point is that nature is governed by laws, laws of cause and effect, for example.
words.sentence_cn: 康德的意思是，自然受法则支配，比如因果法则。
words.speaker: Prof. Michael Sandel
words.why: 康德哲学中区分自然法则与道德法则，是核心术语。
words.def_en: rules that govern how things happen in nature
words.scene_desc: 哈佛《公正》课堂现场 · 时间戳 [09:04]

words.sentence: Now why is autonomy the opposite of the acting heteronomously or according to the dictates of nature?
words.sentence_cn: 那么，为什么自律是与他律地行动、或按自然的命令行动相对立的呢？
words.speaker: Prof. Michael Sandel
words.why: 与自由相对，指受因果法则支配的自然界。
words.def_en: the physical world and all living things, often seen as controlled by natural laws
words.scene_desc: 哈佛《公正》课堂现场 · 时间戳 [08:55]

words.sentence: Only actions done for the sake of the moral law, for the sake of duty, only these actions have moral worth.
words.sentence_cn: 只有为了道德法则、为了义务而做的行为，只有这些行为才具有道德价值。
words.speaker: Prof. Michael Sandel
words.why: 康德伦理学的核心概念，指行为因出于义务而具有的价值。
words.def_en: the quality of being morally good or deserving praise
words.scene_desc: 哈佛《公正》课堂现场 · 时间戳 [15:34]

words.sentence: So he speaks of a different kind of incentive from an inclination; he speaks of reverence for the moral law.
words.sentence_cn: 所以他谈到一种不同于倾向的动机；他谈到对道德法则的敬畏。
words.speaker: Prof. Michael Sandel
words.why: 康德用以描述对道德法则的独特情感，是义务的动机。
words.def_en: a feeling of deep respect and awe for something
words.scene_desc: 哈佛《公正》课堂现场 · 时间戳 [23:19]

words.sentence: And since it's the same capacity for reason, unqualified by particular autobiographies and circumstances, it's the same universal capacity for reason. that delivers the moral law.
words.sentence_cn: 既然这是同一种理性能力，不受特定个人经历和境遇的限制，那它就是同一种普遍的理性能力，正是它给出了道德法则。
words.speaker: Prof. Michael Sandel
words.why: 康德道德法则的普遍性特征，是绝对命令的核心。
words.def_en: true or applicable to all people or things in all situations
words.scene_desc: 哈佛《公正》课堂现场 · 时间戳 [27:06]

words.sentence: Is a reason, it's a kind of practical reason that we share as human beings. It's not idiosyncratic.

words.sentence_cn: 你的论证取决于我们相信，我们会从处于不利地位的底层出发来讨论和制定政策或正义原则。但从证明的角度看，我看不出我们哪里证明了这一点。为什么不能从顶层出发呢？
words.speaker: Prof. Michael Sandel
words.why: disadvantaged 是讨论社会正义与弱势群体时的核心形容词。
words.def_en: lacking the money, education, or chances that most people have
words.scene_desc: 哈佛《公正》课堂现场 · 时间戳 [07:18]

words.sentence: AUDIENCE: In that situation, I would say a merit-based one. One where I don't necessarily know, but I'd rather have a system that rewards me based on my efforts.
words.sentence_cn: 听众：在那种情况下，我会说选择一种择优的制度。一种我未必清楚，但我宁愿要一个根据我的努力来奖励我的制度。
words.speaker: Prof. Michael Sandel
words.why: merit-based 是正义理论中与平等相对的重要分配原则。
words.def_en: based on individual achievement and ability rather than on family background or social class
words.scene_desc: 哈佛《公正》课堂现场 · 时间戳 [08:12]

words.sentence: Or is it regardless of what advantages you may have, when you began your education, to get where you are here?
words.sentence_cn: 还是说，不管你开始接受教育时可能拥有什么优势，都不影响你走到今天这一步？
words.speaker: Prof. Michael Sandel
words.why: regardless of 是学术论证中表示不受条件影响的常用连接词。
words.def_en: without being affected or influenced by something
words.scene_desc: 哈佛《公正》课堂现场 · 时间戳 [08:49]

words.sentence: At the end of the day, it lifts that lowest, that lowest-base level, a community that rewards effort, as opposed to innate differences.
words.sentence_cn: 归根结底，它提升的是最底层，是最底层那个水平——一个奖励努力、而非奖励天生差异的共同体。
words.speaker: Prof. Michael Sandel
words.why: innate differences 涉及天生差异与道德应得，属高阶学术词。
words.def_en: existing naturally in a person from birth rather than being learned
words.scene_desc: 哈佛《公正》课堂现场 · 时间戳 [09:18]

words.sentence: MICHAEL SANDEL: Kate, you suspect that the ability to get into top schools may largely depend on coming from an affluent family, having a favorable family background, social, cultural, economic advantages, and so on?
words.sentence_cn: 迈克尔·桑德尔：凯特，你怀疑能否进入顶尖学校，很大程度上可能取决于是否来自富裕家庭、是否拥有良好的家庭背景、社会、文化、经济方面的优势等等？
words.speaker: Prof. Michael Sandel
words.why: favorable family background 描述有利的家庭背景，学术常用。
words.def_en: having qualities that give an advantage or benefit
words.scene_desc: 哈佛《公正》课堂现场 · 时间戳 [09:51]

words.sentence: Rawls illustrates this by considering several rival theories of justice.
words.sentence_cn: 罗尔斯通过考察几种相互竞争的正义理论来说明这一点。
words.speaker: Prof. Michael Sandel
words.why: rival theories of justice 指相互竞争的理论，学术论证常用。
words.def_en: competing or opposing, especially in a way that tries to be as good as another
words.scene_desc: 哈佛《公正》课堂现场 · 时间戳 [12:20]

words.sentence: You establish a principle that says people may benefit from their good fortune, from their luck in the genetic lottery, but only on terms that work to the advantage of the least-well off.
words.sentence_cn: 你建立一条原则，规定人们可以从自己的好运中获益，从基因彩票中的运气中获益，但只能以有利于最不利者的条件为限。
words.speaker: Prof. Michael Sandel
words.why: genetic lottery（基因彩票）是罗尔斯论证自然天赋道德任意性的关键比喻。
words.def_en: relating to genes or features passed from parents to children
words.scene_desc: 哈佛《公正》课堂现场 · 时间戳 [18:21]

words.sentence: AUDIENCE: I think that it is arbitrary-- and, obviously, it's arbitrary-- but I think that correcting for it would be detrimental. And unlike-- MICHAEL SANDEL: Because it would reduce incentives, is that why? AUDIENCE: It would reduce incentives, yeah.
words.sentence_cn: 观众：我觉得这是随机的——而且显然，它就是随机的——但我认为去纠正它反而会有害。而且不像——桑德尔：因为它会减少激励，是这个原因吗？观众：它会减少激励，是的。
words.speaker: Prof. Michael Sandel
words.why: 用于评价纠正自然偶然性可能带来的负面后果，是学术论证常用词。
words.def_en: s (sometimes followed by `to') causing harm or injury
words.scene_desc: 哈佛《公正》课堂现场 · 时间戳 [20:54]

words.sentence: And I think, from a standpoint of not just this room, us being upset, but, from a societal standpoint, we should have some kind of a gut reaction to that feeling.
words.sentence_cn: 而且我认为，不仅从这间教室、我们感到不安的角度来看，而且从社会的角度来看，我们都应该对那种感受有一种本能的反应。
words.speaker: Prof. Michael Sandel
words.why: societal standpoint 表示从社会整体视角进行伦理判断。
words.def_en: relating to society or the way people live together in a community
words.scene_desc: 哈佛《公正》课堂现场 · 时间戳 [21:21]

words.sentence: Effort, you know what Rawls' answer to that is? Even the effort that some people expend-- conscientious striving, the work ethic-- even effort depends a lot on fortunate family circumstances, for which you, we, can claim no credit.
words.sentence_cn: 努力，你知道罗尔斯对此的回答是什么吗？即便是某些人付出的努力——认真的奋斗、工作伦理——即便是努力也在很大程度上取决于幸运的家庭环境，对此你、我们，都谈不上有什么功劳。
words.speaker: Prof. Michael Sandel
words.why: claim no credit 表示不能将功劳归于自己，是道德应得论证的关键短语。
words.def_en: praise or recognition for something good that someone has done
words.scene_desc: 哈佛《公正》课堂现场 · 时间戳 [22:23]

words.sentence: Those differences are very significant. Put those aside.
words.sentence_cn: 这些差异非常显著。先把它们放一边。
words.speaker: Prof. Michael Sandel
words.why: 学术论证中用于评价差异重要性的高频形容词。
words.def_en: large or important enough to be noticed or to have an effect
words.scene_desc: 哈佛《公正》课堂现场 · 时间戳 [22:55]

words.sentence: A justice of the United States Supreme Court, what do they make? It's just under $200,000.
words.sentence_cn: 美国最高法院的大法官，他们挣多少？略低于20万美元。
words.speaker: Prof. Michael Sandel
words.why: 司法制度核心词汇，用于讨论法官薪酬与分配正义。
words.def_en: a judicial body that decides legal cases, especially the highest one in a country
words.scene_desc: 哈佛《公正》课堂现场 · 时间戳 [24:36]

words.sentence: But there's another judge who makes a lot more than Sandra Day O'Connor.
words.sentence_cn: 但还有另一位法官，挣得比桑德拉·戴·奥康纳多得多。
words.speaker: Prof. Michael Sandel
words.why: 法理学核心角色词，用于比较不同法官的收入以讨论公平。
words.def_en: a person who presides over court proceedings and decides legal cases
words.scene_desc: 哈佛《公正》课堂现场 · 时间戳 [24:46]

words.sentence: Now, is that just? Is it fair?
words.sentence_cn: 那么，这公正吗？这公平吗？
words.speaker: Prof. Michael Sandel
words.why: 正义（just）是法理学与政治哲学的核心评价概念。
words.def_en: fair and morally right, treating everyone equally
words.scene_desc: 哈佛《公正》课堂现场 · 时间戳 [25:05]

words.sentence: and upbringing, "but it still permits the distribution of wealth and income to be determined by the natural distribution of abilities and talents."
words.sentence_cn: 以及教养，“但它仍然允许财富和收入的分配由能力和天赋的自然分布来决定。”
words.speaker: Prof. Michael Sandel
words.why: 与天赋、社会偶然并列，是影响分配的道德任意因素之一。
words.def_en: the way a child is raised and taught by their parents
words.scene_desc: 哈佛《公正》课堂现场 · 时间戳 [16:52]

words.sentence: And what was the significance of that, if you're thinking about these theories of distributive justice?
words.sentence_cn: 如果你在思考这些分配正义的理论，那这件事的意义何在呢？
words.speaker: Prof. Michael Sandel
words.why: 政治哲学核心术语，指社会资源分配的正当性原则。
words.def_en: the fair sharing of wealth, income, and opportunities in a society
words.scene_desc: 哈佛《公正》课堂现场 · 时间戳 [25:44]

words.sentence: So once you're troubled by basing distributive shares on morally arbitrary contingencies, you should, if you reason it through, be carried all the way to what Rawls calls the democratic conception, a more egalitarian conception of distributive justice, that he defines by the difference principle.
words.sentence_cn: 所以，一旦你为把分配份额建立在道德上任意偶然的因素之上而感到不安，只要你推理到底，就应该一路被引向罗尔斯所谓的民主观念，一种更平等主义的分配正义观念，他通过差异原则来定义这种观念。
words.speaker: Prof. Michael Sandel
words.why: 罗尔斯正义理论的核心原则，允许不平等仅当有利于最不利者。
words.def_en: the idea that social and economic inequalities are fair only if they benefit the least advantaged members of society
words.scene_desc: 哈佛《公正》课堂现场 · 时间戳 [28:11]

words.sentence: What about people, working hard, having a right to what they earn because they've deserved it, they've worked hard for it? That's the objection, from effort and moral desert.
words.sentence_cn: 那么那些努力工作的人呢？他们有权得到自己挣来的东西，因为这是他们应得的，他们为此付出了辛勤劳动？这就是基于努力和道德应得的反对意见。
words.speaker: Prof. Michael Sandel
words.why: 关于分配正义中应得基础的重要概念。
words.def_en: the condition of deserving reward or benefit as a result of one's efforts or merits
words.scene_desc: 哈佛《公正》课堂现场 · 时间戳 [35:46]

words.sentence: Isn't there the risk, if taxes reach 70%, 80%, 90% marginal rate, that Michael Jordan won't play?
words.sentence_cn: 难道不会有这样的风险：如果边际税率达到70%、80%、90%，迈克尔·乔丹就不打球了？
words.speaker: Prof. Michael Sandel
words.why: 经济学中描述税收累进性的常用术语。
words.def_en: the tax rate applied to each additional unit of income earned
words.scene_desc: 哈佛《公正》课堂现场 · 时间戳 [32:31]

words.sentence: From the standpoint of the effect of incentives, or disincentives, on the well-being of those at the bottom.
words.sentence_cn: 从激励或反激励对最底层人们福祉的影响这一角度出发。
words.speaker: Prof. Michael Sandel
words.why: 经济学中与激励相对的概念，影响行为。
words.def_en: things that make someone less willing to do something
words.scene_desc: 哈佛《公正》课堂现场 · 时间戳 [34:14]

words.sentence: From the standpoint of the effect of incentives, or disincentives, on the well-being of those at the bottom.
words.sentence_cn: 从激励或反激励对最底层人们福祉的影响这一角度出发。
words.speaker: Prof. Michael Sandel
words.why: 伦理学与政治哲学中衡量生活质量的核心概念。
words.def_en: the state of being healthy, happy, and comfortable
words.scene_desc: 哈佛《公正》课堂现场 · 时间戳 [34:14]

words.sentence: And this objection has to do with reasserting the idea of self-ownership.
words.sentence_cn: 而这个反对意见关乎重申自我所有权的观念。
words.speaker: Prof. Michael Sandel
words.why: 学术写作中表示重新强调某一观点的动词。
words.def_en: to state or demand something again in a strong and clear way
words.scene_desc: 哈佛《公正》课堂现场 · 时间戳 [36:10]

words.sentence: Doesn't the difference principle, by treating our natural talents and endowments as common assets, doesn't that violate the idea that we own ourselves?
words.sentence_cn: 差别原则把我们的天赋和禀赋当作共同资产来对待，这难道不违背我们拥有自身的观念吗？
words.speaker: Prof. Michael Sandel
words.why: 经济学与法学中描述可拥有资源的核心词。
words.def_en: things of value that a person or group owns and can use
words.scene_desc: 哈佛《公正》课堂现场 · 时间戳 [36:21]

words.sentence: Milton Friedman writes, in his book Free to Choose, "Life is not fair," and, "It is tempting to believe that government can rectify what nature has spawned."
words.sentence_cn: 米尔顿·弗里德曼在《自由选择》一书中写道：“生活是不公平的”，以及“人们很容易相信政府能够纠正自然所酿成的东西。”
words.speaker: Prof. Michael Sandel
words.why: 文学性动词，在学术文本中表示引发或产生。
words.def_en: to cause something new to be created or to begin to exist
words.scene_desc: 哈佛《公正》课堂现场 · 时间戳 [36:45]

words.sentence: Because, remember, the first principle we would agree to behind the veil of ignorance is the principle of equal basic liberties, freedom of speech, religious liberty, freedom of conscience, and the like.
words.sentence_cn: 因为，请记住，我们在无知之幕背后会一致同意的第一原则，就是平等的基本自由原则——言论自由、宗教自由、良心自由等等。
words.speaker: Prof. Michael Sandel
words.why: 罗尔斯契约论思想实验的核心装置，用于推导正义原则。
words.def_en: an imaginary situation in which people choose rules without knowing their own place in society
words.scene_desc: 哈佛《公正》课堂现场 · 时间戳 [40:16]

words.sentence: Because, remember, the first principle we would agree to behind the veil of ignorance is the principle of equal basic liberties, freedom of speech, religious liberty, freedom of conscience, and the like.
words.sentence_cn: 因为，请记住，我们在无知之幕背后会一致同意的第一原则，就是平等的基本自由原则——言论自由、宗教自由、良心自由等等。
words.speaker: Prof. Michael Sandel
words.why: 罗尔斯第一正义原则的正式名称，包含言论、宗教与良心自由。
words.def_en: the same fundamental rights and freedoms for all people
words.scene_desc: 哈佛《公正》课堂现场 · 时间戳 [40:16]

words.sentence: His first answer is, even the work ethic, even the willingness to strive conscientiously, depends on all sorts of family circumstances and social and cultural contingencies for which we can claim no credit.
words.sentence_cn: 他的第一个回答是：即便是工作伦理，即便是自觉努力奋斗的意愿，也取决于各种家庭境况以及社会和文化上的偶然因素，而这些都不是我们自己的功劳。
words.speaker: Prof. Michael Sandel
words.why: 学术论证中常用来指对努力工作的道德评价，此处被罗尔斯质疑其来源。
words.def_en: the belief that hard work is good and should be done with care
words.scene_desc: 哈佛《公正》课堂现场 · 时间戳 [42:03]

words.sentence: And another construction worker is small and scrawny and has to spend three days to do the same amount of work.
words.sentence_cn: 而另一个建筑工人身材矮小、骨瘦如柴，得花三天才能干完同样多的活。
words.speaker: Prof. Michael Sandel
words.why: 低频描述性形容词，在论证中用于对比体力差异，影响听力理解。
words.def_en: very thin and bony, with little muscle or fat
words.scene_desc: 哈佛《公正》课堂现场 · 时间戳 [43:05]

words.sentence: So it isn't really effort-- this is the second reply to the meritocratic claim. It isn't really effort that the defender of meritocracy believes is the moral basis of distributive shares, its contribution, how much do you contribute.
words.sentence_cn: 所以，真正的依据并不是努力——这是对功绩制主张的第二个回应。功绩制的辩护者认为分配份额的道德基础并不是努力，而是贡献，也就是你贡献了多少。
words.speaker: Prof. Michael Sandel
words.why: 分配正义理论中的核心术语，指社会合作产生的利益与负担的分配。
words.def_en: the amounts of goods, wealth, or benefits that each person receives
words.scene_desc: 哈佛《公正》课堂现场 · 时间戳 [43:26]

words.sentence: Now, here, Rawls introduces an important, and a tricky, distinction. It's between moral desert, on the one hand, and entitlements to legitimate expectations on the other.
words.sentence_cn: 那么，在这里，罗尔斯引入了一个重要而微妙的区分。一方面是道德应得，另一方面是对合法期望的资格。
words.speaker: Prof. Michael Sandel
words.why: 罗尔斯正义理论中与道德应得相对的概念，指基于社会制度产生的正当预期。
words.def_en: reasonable hopes or claims that people are entitled to have, based on accepted rules or promises
words.scene_desc: 哈佛《公正》课堂现场 · 时间戳 [44:45]

words.sentence: That's an antecedent standard, moral desert.
words.sentence_cn: 那是一个先决的标准，即道德应得。
words.speaker: Prof. Michael Sandel
words.why: 学术论证中表示逻辑上在先的标准，此处指道德应得先于制度规则。
words.def_en: n. a preceding occurrence or cause or event n. anything that precedes something similar in time n. the referent of an anaphor; a phrase or clause that is referred to by an anaphoric pronoun
words.scene_desc: 哈佛《公正》课堂现场 · 时间戳 [46:26]

words.sentence: But what they are entitled to is not proportional to," nor "dependent on their intrinsic worth.
words.sentence_cn: 但他们有资格得到的东西，并不与他们的内在价值成比例，也不取决于他们的内在价值。
words.speaker: Prof. Michael Sandel
words.why: 道德哲学核心概念，指事物自身固有的价值，此处与分配份额无关。
words.def_en: the value that something or someone has in itself, not depending on outside factors
words.scene_desc: 哈佛《公正》课堂现场 · 时间戳 [47:02]

words.sentence: But there's a second contingency, a second source of moral arbitrariness, that goes beyond the question of whether it's to my credit that I have the talents that enable me to get ahead.
words.sentence_cn: 但还有第二种偶然性，第二个道德任意性的来源，它超出了我拥有那些让我出人头地的才能是否算我的功劳这一问题。
words.speaker: Prof. Michael Sandel
words.why: 罗尔斯论证中表示从道德观点看缺乏正当理由的偶然性。
words.def_en: the absence of any principled reason for treating people differently
words.scene_desc: 哈佛《公正》课堂现场 · 时间戳 [47:35]

words.sentence: The fact that David Letterman lives in a society that puts a great premium, puts a great value, on a certain type of smirky joke, that's not his doing. He's lucky that he happens to live in such a society.
words.sentence_cn: 大卫·莱特曼生活在一个特别看重、特别推崇某种坏笑式笑话的社会里，这不是他的功劳。他碰巧生活在这样一个社会里，是他的运气。
words.speaker: Prof. Michael Sandel
words.why: 在学术语境中常与 put a premium on 搭配，表示赋予极高价值。
words.def_en: a high value or importance placed on something
words.scene_desc: 哈佛《公正》课堂现场 · 时间戳 [47:59]

words.sentence: What other people happen to want, or like, in this society. It depends on the law of supply and demand.
words.sentence_cn: 在这个社会里，其他人碰巧想要什么、喜欢什么。这取决于供求关系。
words.speaker: Prof. Michael Sandel
words.why: 经济学基础术语，此处用于说明市场回报取决于他人偏好而非个人应得。
words.def_en: the relationship between how much of a product is available and how much people want it
words.scene_desc: 哈佛《公正》课堂现场 · 时间戳 [48:51]

words.sentence: In a capitalist society, it helps to have entrepreneurial drive.
words.sentence_cn: 在资本主义社会里，有创业的干劲是很有用的。
words.speaker: Prof. Michael Sandel
words.why: 描述资本主义社会所重视的才能，属于学术与商业交叉高频词。
words.def_en: relating to starting and running a business, often with risk
words.scene_desc: 哈佛《公正》课堂现场 · 时间戳 [49:31]

words.sentence: In a bureaucratic society, it helps to get on easily and smoothly with superiors.
words.sentence_cn: 在官僚社会里，能和上级轻松顺畅地相处是很有用的。
words.speaker: Prof. Michael Sandel
words.why: 政治学与社会学常用词，描述科层制社会所重视的才能。
words.def_en: relating to a system of official rules and procedures that is complicated and slow
words.scene_desc: 哈佛《公正》课堂现场 · 时间戳 [49:35]

words.sentence: In a bureaucratic society, it helps to get on easily and smoothly with superiors.
words.sentence_cn: 在官僚社会里，能和上级轻松顺畅地相处是很有用的。
words.speaker: Prof. Michael Sandel
words.why: 职场与科层制语境中的常用词，影响听力理解。
words.def_en: people of higher rank or position than you in an organization
